title: Mind Your Inflections! Improving NLP for Non-Standard Englishes with Base-Inflection Encoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness against inflectional adversarial attacks (using MORPHEUS) on QA and NLI tasks to simulate non-standard inflections, and measuring pseudo perplexity (pPPL) of language models on monodialectal corpora representing African American Vernacular English (AAVE) and Colloquial Singapore English (CSE).
